title: Senior Software Engineer - Azure
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Develop, test, and maintain scalable web applications using Java-based technologies
* Design and implement RESTful APIs and backend services using Spring Boot
* Build responsive and user-friendly frontend applications using Angular, React, or JavaScript frameworks
* Work with databases to design, develop, and optimize SQL queries and data models
* Proven solid analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance innovation and pragmatism
* Proven passion for learning and staying updated with the latest AI/ML trends and research
  
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline
* 1+ years of experience in Software Engineering skills
* Experience working with cross-functional and distributed teams in a global and diverse environment
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and GCP
* Experience with DevOps and CI/CD tools and practices including Git, Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes
* Exposure to Kubernetes and containerized deployments. Knowledge of design patterns and secure coding practices
* Deep expertise in modern software engineering practices including AI/ML/Generative AI, Agile methodologies, and DevOps to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from code check-in to production across the full SDLC lifecycle
* Familiarity with DevOps concepts and CI/CD pipelines
* Proven background in healthcare (AI)
* Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Systems Architect - AWS Cloud with AI
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking a **Systems Architect – AWS Cloud with AI** to lead enterprise-scale cloud migration and transformation initiatives, design robust AWS architectures and drive the adoption of AI-enabled cloud solutions for our clients.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end AWS cloud migration and transformation strategies covering assessment, migration planning, execution, cutover, optimization and modernization
* Design enterprise AWS Landing Zones, multi-account architectures, governance frameworks, networking, identity, security and automation standards
* Define target-state cloud-native and AI-enabled architectures by translating business and engineering requirements into scalable, resilient and cost-optimized solutions
* Lead client-facing architecture workshops, executive briefings and technical decision-making, representing the company as a senior cloud architecture advisor
* Create and govern architecture assets including high-level designs, migration blueprints, wave plans, feature breakdowns, estimations, risk assessments, playbooks and system blueprints
* Lead technical solutioning for RFPs and proposals, including cloud transformation and migration approaches, business cases, effort estimates, assumptions, risks and cost models
* Coordinate and guide delivery teams, including mid-sized teams of 6+ members, while mentoring architects and engineers and supporting project planning across budget, timeline and migration complexity
* Evaluate external vendor proposals, conduct architecture reviews and ensure solutions align with AWS and industry best practices for scalability, resilience, security, performance and cost optimization

**Requirements**

* 16-25 years of overall IT experience, with strong expertise in enterprise AWS cloud and systems architecture across EC2, S3, VPC, ELB/ALB, IAM, RDS, Lambda, CloudFormation and CloudWatch
* Expertise in AWS Landing Zones, Control Tower, multi-account strategy, Service Control Policies (SCPs), IAM, governance and enterprise cloud operating models
* Proven experience leading large-scale AWS migration programs, including application and infrastructure assessment, migration planning, wave-based execution, cutover and post-migration optimization
* Knowledge of AWS Migration Factory approaches and migration tooling such as AWS Server Migration Service (SMS) / Application Migration Service, including rehost, replatform and refactor strategies
* Experience in AWS networking and security architecture covering Transit Gateway, NACLs, Security Groups, AWS Network Firewall, hybrid connectivity, resilience and security best practices
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation and/or CDK, along with CI/CD, GitOps and platform automation practices
* Experience with cloud-native modernization using EKS, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, microservices, containers, serverless and event-driven architecture patterns
* Understanding of Generative AI and Agentic AI concepts, including RAG, LLM integrations and AWS AI/ML services such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker and OpenSearch for vector search
* Customer-facing consulting, architecture documentation, estimation, RFP/RFI solutioning and stakeholder management experience, with the ability to lead technical teams and architecture discussions
* AWS certification such as Solutions Architect – Professional or active pursuit of relevant AWS certification, along with a strong continuous-learning mindset and ITIL Foundation exposure

**Nice to have**

* Knowledge of multi-cloud and hybrid cloud architectures
* Exposure to service mesh and advanced container platforms including EKS, ECS and AWS App Mesh
* TOGAF, SEI or other enterprise architecture certifications
* Additional hands-on exposure to GenAI/Agentic AI solution patterns and AI-enabled cloud transformation programs

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

The Opportunity

This role shapes the end-to-end design and delivery of resilient cloud-native data platforms and microservices. You’ll set technical direction across modernisation of legacy estates while staying close enough to the code to unblock teams and strengthen engineering quality in Java and distributed system design. The focus spans high-performance data pipelines, event-driven integration and production-ready operational standards in a regulated environment. Success means services that are scalable, observable and secure with clear roadmaps that reduce risk and disruption to live operations. You’ll influence senior stakeholders by translating business outcomes into pragmatic technical plans and measurable milestones.

What you'll be doing

* Own solution architecture for high-performance data pipelines and microservices including resilience, scalability, latency, observability and security
* Define modernisation roadmaps across re-platforming, refactoring and microservices decomposition with minimal disruption to live services
* Establish engineering standards for API design, event-driven integration, data modelling, testing strategy, CI/CD and operational readiness
* Manage technical debt through clear prioritisation and measurable outcomes
* Architect, design and build core services using Java (8+), Spring Boot 3, JPA and PostgreSQL (or other RDBMS) using event streaming patterns
* Deliver real-time processing implementations using Apache Flink and/or Apache Beam where appropriate
* Partner with engineers on code reviews, pair debugging, performance tuning and production incident resolution
* Own operational excellence on GCP across monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, reliability improvements and cost optimisation

What we're looking for

* Bring substantial software engineering experience designing and delivering distributed systems and data-intensive applications
* Demonstrate recent hands-on Java engineering expertise using Spring Boot with REST and event-driven services
* Apply proven system design across microservices patterns, asynchronous messaging, idempotency, consistency models, caching, rate limiting and failure handling
* Show strong SQL capability including performance tuning and working effectively with ORM frameworks such as JPA/Hibernate
* Deliver cloud-native solutions on GCP or an equivalent cloud platform with the ability to translate patterns and services
* Troubleshoot across application, data, infrastructure and performance layers to restore service quickly and prevent recurrence
* Communicate architecture decisions clearly and connect them to business priorities and operational constraints
* Coach and mentor engineers across levels to strengthen craftsmanship, accountability and continuous improvement

Building resilient data services

If you want to shape modern cloud-native platforms while staying hands-on with Java engineering this role offers real scope to make a visible difference. You’ll set direction for microservices and data pipelines that need to perform under demanding production conditions. The work spans architecture, delivery and operational excellence so improvements show up in reliability, scalability and engineering efficiency. If this aligns with the kind of platform work you want to own we’d welcome your application.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

www.hsbc.com/careers

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by – HSBC Software Development India

title: Associate Principal Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

**We're Nagarro.**

We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at a scale — across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (18500+ experts across 39 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in!

 **Job Description**

**Requirements**

* Experience : 9+years
* Relevant experience in data engineering, database development, or cloud data platforms.
* Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake architecture, data loading, SQL development, performance optimization, and security.
* Strong proficiency in advanced SQL, including complex joins, window functions, stored procedures, query profiling, and troubleshooting.
* Strong Python programming skills for data processing, automation, API integration, and error handling.
* Hands-on experience developing and maintaining data pipelines using Azure Data Factory or comparable integration tools.
* Practical experience with Snowflake Cortex AI, including Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, and AI agent creation.
* Experience with Snowpark for data transformation, processing, and application integration.
* Strong understanding of ETL/ELT patterns, incremental loading, CDC, data validation, and data quality management.
* Experience designing and maintaining dimensional and relational data models, semantic views, and semantic models.
* Understanding of natural-language-to-SQL, semantic search, keyword search, embeddings, text chunking, and RAG concepts.
* Experience integrating Snowflake AI capabilities with enterprise applications through APIs and Python.
* Knowledge of Snowflake security and governance features, including RBAC, masking policies, row access policies, and auditing.
* Experience with Git, Azure DevOps, version control, and automated deployment practices.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and translate business requirements into scalable data and AI solutions.
* Experience mentoring junior engineers and following coding standards, documentation practices, and code review processes.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable Snowflake data architectures to support data storage, processing, reporting, analytics, and AI-driven use cases.
* Develop and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using advanced SQL, Python, Snowpark, Azure Data Factory, and other integration tools such as SnapLogic.
* Integrate structured and semi-structured data from databases, APIs, enterprise applications, and files, and prepare unstructured content for AI processing.
* Implement full-load, incremental-load, and Change Data Capture (CDC) processes with appropriate data validation, reconciliation, error handling, and recovery mechanisms.
* Develop and maintain dimensional and relational data models aligned with business requirements.
* Build, configure, and optimize Snowflake tables, views, stored procedures, tasks, streams, and dynamic tables.
* Analyze query profiles and optimize warehouse sizing, clustering, partition pruning, and caching to improve performance and control costs.
* Review and enhance SQL and Python code to improve efficiency, security, reliability, and maintainability.
* Implement data quality checks to ensure data completeness, accuracy, consistency, validity, and deduplication.
* Design and implement AI-enabled data solutions using Snowflake Cortex AI, Snowpark, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, and AI agents.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.

  

Key Responsibilities
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
Compliance & Security:
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.

Core Responsibilities
  
Planning & Execution:
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
Problem Solving:
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
Continuous Learning:
  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
Performance and Development:
  
–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

title: Senior Security Architect
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking a **Senior Security Architect** to define and guide the technical approach for vulnerability analysis, prioritization, remediation patterns, and engineering enablement across a large-scale portfolio. This role will provide architectural leadership across application security, cloud security, and software supply-chain risk domains, working closely with development, platform, TechOps, and application teams to drive repeatable, scalable remediation practices across an environment of approximately 4,600 repositories, 20 major product groupings, and 1,800 developers.

**Responsibilities**

* Provide architecture and technical leadership for the Vulnerability Management workstream
* Establish approaches for vulnerability analysis, validation, prioritization, and remediation planning
* Guide remediation efforts across application and security code findings, cloud configuration risks, and vulnerable dependencies
* Define reusable fix patterns, remediation playbooks, and technical runbooks
* Support engineers on complex vulnerabilities and root-cause analysis
* Review proof-of-concept fixes and remediation recommendations
* Help product teams reduce recurring vulnerabilities by improving engineering and security practices
* Support risk reporting and recurring vulnerability trend analysis
* Deliver senior architectural guidance while enabling engineers to execute repeatable remediation work at scale
* Support DevSecOps controls, automated quality gates, and Golden Pipeline modernization efforts
* Contribute to migration readiness, execution, and post-migration stabilization activities related to GitHub and DevSecOps transformation

**Requirements**

* 12-20 years of overall experience in IT, with a strong background in security architecture and vulnerability management
* Expertise in SAST/DAST, Checkmarx, and CodeQL for secure code review and secure SDLC practices
* Proficiency in cloud security, including AWS, Wiz, and IAM and cloud configuration and infrastructure security
* Knowledge of software supply-chain security, including JFrog Xray, dependency security, and SBOM concepts
* Skills in vulnerability management, threat/risk analysis, and remediation architecture
* Understanding of security automation and DevSecOps principles
* Familiarity with GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps pipeline migration, including runners, secrets, permissions, and deployment integrations
* Capability to define and guide remediation playbooks and technical runbooks at scale across large, complex portfolios

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Principal AI/ML Architect
description:
**About Egen**:

  

Egen is a fast-growing, entrepreneurial technology company with a data-first mindset. We bring together exceptional engineering talent and advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights.

We are committed to being a place where talented people choose to do their best work - applying deep engineering and technology expertise to envision how data, AI, and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving difficult problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If that describes you, we want you on our team.

### **About the opportunity:**

As a Principal AI/ML Architect, you will set the technical direction for Egen's most complex generative AI, agentic AI, and applied machine learning engagements while remaining personally hands-on in the work that matters most. We treat AI as a software engineering discipline. You will raise that bar by architecting systems that succeed in production and helping the engineers around you do the same.

  

You will own the hardest architectural problems in our portfolio: agentic platforms operating at scale, applied-ML solutions, advanced retrieval systems, and AI in regulated or high-stakes environments where being wrong is expensive. Document intelligence and RAG pipelines are part of your toolkit, not the ceiling. You will take systems from an ambiguous business problem to a robust, scalable service, solving for latency, reliability, cost, security, and governance.

  

You will also be the senior technical face of our engagements. You will partner directly with client leadership to translate business strategy into AI architecture, shape solutions during pre-sales, guide engineering teams, and earn the trust that turns a project into a long-term program.

### **What you will do:**

* **Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction:** Own the end-to-end architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices across engagements.
* **Build at the frontier - hands-on:** Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
* **Engineer AI for production:** Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, and continuously improved.
* **Architect agentic systems at scale:** Design and operate multi-step reasoning and multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls.

* **Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards:** Define measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle.
* **Shape data and retrieval architectures:** Design production-scale retrieval and knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous content refresh.
* **Advise clients and shape opportunities:** Partner with client executives and engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off discussions, and pre-sales solutioning.
* **Multiply engineering capability:** Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater confidence.
* **Own outcomes across the full lifecycle:** Guide initiatives from problem framing and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions to resolution.

### **Your technical toolkit:**

**Languages and software engineering**

Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting; API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership.

  

**Models and AI ecosystem**

Deep, current expertise with Google Gemini, GPT-class models, LLaMA and other open models; advanced prompt engineering; structured outputs; model selection; fine-tuning; and rigorous evaluation.

  

**Agentic AI engineering**

Hands-on production experience with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangChain, custom agent frameworks, tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), workflow orchestration, planning, memory, state, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and multi-agent design.

  

**Retrieval and search**

Advanced RAG, hybrid and semantic search, embeddings, re-ranking, and vector platforms such as Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies.

  

**Cloud infrastructure and AI systems**

End-to-end experience architecting highly available, scalable AI and software environments across Google Cloud / Vertex AI, AWS, and Azure, including model serving, data integration, IAM, networking, security, observability, and cost management.

  

**Frameworks**

Strong command of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration layers - together with the judgment to use simpler, more maintainable patterns when appropriate.

  

**MLOps and LLMOps**

CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, rollback, and production incident response.

  

**Data and ML foundations**

Strong SQL and data engineering; classical machine learning; neural networks; training, tuning, and inference; and the ability to connect data quality to model and product outcomes.

### **Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

* 15+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, machine learning, data, or AI, including substantial ownership of production systems at scale.
* Demonstrated principal-level technical leadership, including architecture ownership, cross-team technical direction, and decision-making across complex engagements or product portfolios.
* A proven record of deploying generative AI, agentic AI, and/or applied-ML products into production - beyond proofs of concept.
* Deep hands-on expertise with Python, modern LLM and ML architectures, agent frameworks, Google Cloud / Vertex AI, production APIs, and scalable software systems.
* Experience establishing evaluation, observability, security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI controls for enterprise AI solutions.
* Strong data engineering and SQL knowledge, with the ability to design reliable data and retrieval foundations for AI products.
* Senior client-facing experience, with the communication skills to explain technical choices, risks, and business value to executive stakeholders and engineering teams.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience training, tuning, or adapting neural networks, embedding models, or foundation models.
* Architecture experience in regulated or high-stakes domains such as healthcare, financial services, or the public sector.
* Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, or comparable certification.
* Experience building reusable AI accelerators, reference implementations, or platform capabilities across multiple clients or product teams.
* Pre-sales experience including discovery workshops, solution shaping, estimation, proposal development, and technical presentations.
* Familiarity or good to have understanding with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, event-driven architectures, and modern data platforms.

title: 1-5 yrs Exp Revit Architecture and structural modeler
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled Revit Architectural and Structural Modeler with 2–5 years of experience in Building Information Modeling (BIM). The candidate will be responsible for developing accurate 3D architectural and structural models using Autodesk Revit, preparing detailed drawings, coordinating with multidisciplinary teams, and ensuring compliance with project standards and BIM requirements.

Key ResponsibilitiesArchitectural Modeling

* Develop and maintain 3D architectural models using Autodesk Revit.
* Create architectural floor plans, elevations, sections, reflected ceiling plans, and detailed drawings.
* Model walls, doors, windows, floors, roofs, stairs, ceilings, and other architectural elements.
* Prepare architectural schedules, annotations, dimensions, and construction documentation.
* Interpret architectural design drawings, CAD drawings, and project specifications.
* Develop and manage Revit families and parametric components as required.

Structural Modeling

* Develop 3D structural models using Revit Structure.
* Model structural elements, including foundations, footings, columns, beams, slabs, shear walls, and structural framing.
* Prepare structural plans, sections, elevations, and reinforcement details where required.
* Coordinate architectural and structural models to identify and resolve clashes.
* Understand structural drawings and coordinate with structural engineers to address discrepancies.
* Maintain model accuracy and consistency with approved structural design drawings.

BIM Coordination and Documentation

* Perform architectural and structural model coordination.
* Identify and report clashes and discrepancies between disciplines.
* Work with Navisworks for clash detection and model review, where required.
* Maintain project-specific BIM standards, naming conventions, worksets, and model organization.
* Support the preparation of construction drawings, shop drawings, and as-built models.
* Update models based on design revisions and coordination comments.
* Collaborate with architects, structural engineers, BIM coordinators, and other project team members.
* Meet project deadlines while maintaining quality and accuracy.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of hands-on experience in Autodesk Revit Architecture and/or Revit Structure.
* Good understanding of architectural and structural drawings.
* Knowledge of 3D modeling, BIM workflows, and construction documentation.
* Familiarity with Revit families, worksharing, worksets, and model linking.
* Understanding of architectural and structural coordination principles.
* Basic knowledge of AutoCAD.
* Familiarity with Navisworks, clash detection, and BIM coordination is an advantage.
* Good communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.
* Ability to work independently and deliver accurate models within project timelines.

Preferred Skills

* Knowledge of BIM execution plans (BEP) and Level of Development (LOD) requirements.
* Familiarity with Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) or BIM 360.
* Understanding of ISO 19650 BIM standards.
* Experience working on residential, commercial, industrial, or infrastructure projects.
* Knowledge of Dynamo or other BIM automation tools is an added advantage.

Job Types: Full-time, Contractual / Temporary

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

Work Location: In person

title: Solutions Architect
description:
### **Description**

As a Solution Architect, you will lead the architecture and solution design of large-scale technology initiatives spanning multiple systems across the OTT platform ecosystem.

You will be responsible for translating business and product requirements into scalable, secure, resilient and maintainable technical solutions that align with the organization's strategic objectives.

Our culture is highly delivery-focused, and the role extends well beyond producing architecture diagrams and design documentation.  
  
You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Programme Management, Operations and external partners throughout the delivery lifecycle, providing hands-on architectural guidance, resolving technical challenges, managing design trade-offs and ensuring successful implementation of solutions through to production release.

  

### **What you'll be doing:**

* **Solution Architecture:** Lead the architecture and solution design of strategic initiatives across the OTT platform ecosystem, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technology strategy.

* **Architectural Evolution:** Drive architectural evolution by assessing existing systems, identifying improvement opportunities and challenging established assumptions and technical constraints, including the pragmatic application of AI-enabled tools and capabilities where they deliver measurable value.

* **End-to-End Delivery:** Own solution delivery from concept through implementation, providing technical leadership, resolving complex challenges and ensuring successful outcomes.

* **Scalable Solution Design:** Design scalable, secure, resilient and maintainable solutions, defining both functional and non-functional requirements and producing key architectural artefacts, including requirements for responsible AI use, data privacy, security, observability and governance where AI capabilities are involved.

* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Delivery and Business stakeholders to ensure solutions adhere to architectural principles, standards and best practices.

* **Architecture Reviews:** Conduct architecture reviews, identify and mitigate technical risks, dependencies and gaps, and drive continuous quality improvement.

* **Engineering Guidance:** Support engineering teams throughout delivery with architectural guidance, governance and decision-making for complex technical issues. Promote effective and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering and delivery practices.

* **Technology Innovation:** Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, OTT best practices and relevant AI capabilities to enhance platform capabilities, engineering efficiency and long-term architectural sustainability.

  

### **What you'll bring:**

  
6+ years' experience as a Solution Architect or similar role, designing and delivering large-scale technology solutions in complex environments.  

Deep understanding of OTT platform architectures and domains, including subscriptions, monetisation, identity and access management (IAM), content and metadata management, and related platform services.  
* Proven experience designing and delivering scalable, distributed systems using **Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture (EDA)** principles.
* Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures and services, preferably **AWS**.
Strong solution design expertise, including integration and management of third-party vendor solutions and in-house platforms.  
* **AI fluency:** Practical understanding of Generative AI, Machine Learning and AI-enabled platform capabilities.
Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve architecture, analysis, documentation, engineering productivity and problem-solving, while validating outputs and retaining appropriate technical judgement.  
Ability to assess AI use cases, dependencies, risks and non-functional requirements.  
* Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, with hands-on experience in technologies such as **Node.js, Java, Python or Go**, and strong knowledge of database technologies.
Proven ability to solve complex business and technology challenges, navigate ambiguity and drive effective technical outcomes.  
Experience analysing and optimising business processes, operating models and technology landscapes.  
Strong documentation skills and experience applying industry-standard architecture and design methodologies.  
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions and communicate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.  
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

  

### **About DAZN**

At DAZN, we bring ambition to life. We are innovators, game-changers and pioneers. So, if you want to push boundaries and make an impact, DAZN is the place to be.

As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make your mark and the power to make change happen. We're doing things no-one has done before, giving fans and customers access to sport anytime, anywhere. title: Principal Engineer – Knowledge, Data & RAG Engineering- Assistant Vice President
description:
**Who we are looking for**

We are looking for an experienced Architect to lead enterprise architecture for knowledge and data engineering, RAG, and Graph RAG. Experience in Agentic AI, orchestration, testing, evaluation, and governance is desirable. Working with architecture, data, AI, security, risk, product, testing, and application teams, you will turn business strategy into practical architectures, standards, roadmaps, and delivery controls. You will bring strong architectural leadership and expertise in semantic technologies, modern data platforms, and retrieval systems.

  

**Why this role is important to us**

Enterprise AI depends on trusted, well-engineered, permission-aware, traceable, and continuously validated data and knowledge. This role establishes the architectural foundation that connects source systems, data pipelines, semantic models, knowledge graphs, retrieval services, models, agents, controls, testing, and business workflows. The Architect will reduce fragmented point solutions, promote reusable capabilities, guide investment decisions, and ensure that AI applications and agents retrieve reliable evidence, generate grounded responses, execute approved actions, and remain secure, observable, auditable, resilient, and compliant throughout their lifecycle.

  

**About the team — Alpha Intelligence**

Alpha Intelligence is State Street’s AI & Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations — the team rewiring how the industry’s first front-to-back platform gets delivered. We turn the deep expertise locked inside our implementation teams into engineered processes, governed knowledge and intelligent agents that cut manual effort, compress client go-live timelines and make every implementation faster and more predictable than the last.

We operate as one global team across the North America, EMEA, and APAC , combining process engineering, automation delivery, AI platform engineering and responsible-AI governance under a single roof. We work on real client implementations, not pilots that sit on a shelf — what we build is adopted, measured and scaled. If you want to shape how AI is applied to one of the most complex delivery landscapes in financial services, this is the team to do it in.

  

**What you will be responsible for**

Own the enterprise architecture for Knowledge Engineering, Data Engineering, RAG and Graph RAG, Agentic AI, testing, and governance, aligning strategy, platforms, delivery, controls, and measurable outcomes.

  

* Define the enterprise vision, target architecture, standards, reusable patterns, and roadmap across data, knowledge, retrieval, AI agents, testing, and governance.
* Translate business priorities into scalable solution architectures, transition plans, investment decisions, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead knowledge and data architecture, including ontologies, semantic models, knowledge graphs, metadata, lineage, data pipelines, quality, and lifecycle management.
* Architect production-grade RAG and Graph RAG services covering ingestion, indexing, hybrid retrieval, ranking, grounding, citations, provenance, and feedback.
* Establish testing, evaluation, and release standards for data quality, retrieval, prompts.
* Embed testing, monitoring, traceability, rollback, and governance controls in delivery pipelines.
* Lead architecture reviews, align stakeholders, and guide technical teams.
  

**What we value**

The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, enterprise architecture perspective, deep technical credibility, and a quality-and-risk mindset. The candidate must communicate complex architectural choices, test evidence, control requirements, risks, and trade-offs clearly to engineering teams, business stakeholders, governance forums, auditors, and senior technology leaders. We value pragmatic architecture, business-value alignment, secure-by-design and test-by-design practices, reuse, interoperability, measurable quality, transparent decision making, and continuously governed enterprise AI outcomes.

  

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

**Must-have skills**

* Strong experience in enterprise architecture, technical leadership, and working with cross-functional teams.
* Strong data engineering expertise across ETL/ELT, batch and streaming pipelines, lakehouse or warehouse platforms, data quality, and DataOps.
* Expertise in designing ontologies and semantic models and implementing end-to-end RAG and Graph RAG pipelines, including ingestion, chunking, embeddings, indexing, hybrid retrieval, semantic search, graph traversal, ranking, grounding, provenance, and evaluation.
* Strong knowledge of Responsible AI, privacy, access control, model risk, auditability, regulatory compliance, and policy enforcement.
* Experience delivering solutions in financial services or another regulated industry.

**Nice-to-have skills**

* Exposure to modern data, streaming, workflow, monitoring, vector database, and enterprise search tools such as Snowflake, Databricks, Kafka, dbt, or Airflow would be useful.
* Familiarity with AI platforms or frameworks such as Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Vertex AI, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or MLflow would be beneficial.
* Awareness of Model Context Protocol, connecting AI agents with tools, access controls, monitoring, and AI security would be helpful.
* Experience establishing automated testing, quality gates, monitoring, traceability, release, and rollback controls within CI/CD and MLOps/LLMOps.
* An understanding of cloud costs, capacity planning, and communicating architecture proposals to senior stakeholders would be useful.
* Relevant certifications in architecture, cloud, data, graph, testing, security, governance, or Generative AI would be a plus.
  

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred; a master’s degree would be a plus.
* Extensive technology experience, ideally including architecture, data or knowledge engineering, software or AI engineering, testing, governance, or enterprise platforms.
* Experience providing architectural guidance and contributing to standards, roadmaps, governance, and key design decisions would be valuable.
* Exposure to delivering secure, scalable, and well-governed data platforms, knowledge graphs, ontologies, RAG or Graph RAG services, Agentic AI, or Generative AI solutions would be beneficial.
* The ability to work with senior stakeholders and bring business, architecture, engineering, testing, cloud, security, risk, and operations teams together would be helpful.
* Relevant certifications in architecture, cloud, data, graph, testing, security, governance, or Generative AI would be a plus.
  

  

**About State Street**
======================

  

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

  
  

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

  
  

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

title: Wifi Architect
description:
Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech! 
  
  
Who Are We?
  
  
For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  
For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L’Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty.
  
  
Today, L’Oréal includes more than 2,000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future.
  
  
Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L’Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure.
  
  
A Day in the Life of Wifi Architect
  
  

* Attends design committees with Global Network team and work in pair with his peers to define the Network architecture strategy.
* Develop detailed network architecture blueprints and integration diagrams tailored to business and technical requirements.
* Lead architecture discussion and translate the decisions in High Level Design documents and operational procedures
* Establish technical standards, patterns and best practices
* Validation of Document solutions designs, data flows and integration points.
* Provide architectural guidance and troubleshooting support to implementation and operations teams.
* Participate in technical workshops, design sessions and code reviews.
* Participate with implementation team for Automation.
* Present architectural solutions, technical decisions and progress updates to stakeholders.
* Able to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
* Stay updated on identity technologies trends and incorporate enhancements or optimizations.

Design and supervise the integration of solutions with identity environment
  
  
In this role, You will..
  
  
**Be responsible for the following:**  
**Solution Architecture and Design:**  

* Architect for design, integration and management of Cisco Meraki and Enterprise solution.
* Architect for design, integration and management of Authentication solution.
* Analyze current business processes, IT infrastructure, and security requirements to develop security of our network solution.
* Develop high-level and detailed architecture diagrams, technical documentation, and integration designs.

description:
### **When you join Verizon**

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. ### **What you’ll be doing...**

This role requires a visionary technology leader who will champion the integration of Generative AI technologies into our projects. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise to drive innovation, enhance product offerings, and create efficient solutions that align with our strategic goals.

### **1. AI Architecture, Agentic Systems & MLOps**

* **Agentic Workflows & Digital Workers:** Design and operationalize GenAI-powered agents, LLMs, RAG, and multi-agent frameworks that function as digital workers—automating complex decision-making for CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote), ordering, orchestration, inventory, and service assurance.
* **Process Mapping & Platform Integration:** Analyze enterprise workflows to define operational logic, boundary conditions, and guardrails for agents deployed on the **AI** platform, ensuring high reusability and fast speed-to-value.
* **Foundation Model Management:** Integrate state-of-the-art foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source via Hugging Face/vLLM) while managing model routing, latency budgets, token cost optimization, and semantic caching.
* **LLMOps & Governance:** Establish MLOps/LLMOps pipelines featuring real-time model monitoring, fine-tuning, safety guardrails, automated CI/CD deployments, and evaluation pipelines (e.g., LangSmith, Phoenix) to guarantee output quality, security, and compliance.

### **2. Full Stack & Distributed Systems Architecture**

* **End-to-End Systems Engineering:** Oversee the architectural blueprint for web applications, microservices, and event-driven asynchronous pipelines across frontend, backend, and cloud environments.
* **High-Performance Frontends:** Architect dynamic, real-time user interfaces capable of streaming response handling (Server-Sent Events / WebSockets) and dynamic AI UI components. NodeJS, Angular is a must.
* **API & Microservices Design:** Build robust, highly concurrent, low-latency APIs (REST, GraphQL, gRPC) and microservice layers powering critical enterprise workflows.

### **3. Cloud, Data Engineering & Analytics**

* **Multi-Cloud & Streaming Strategy:** Build and scale data analytics and real-time streaming pipelines across cloud environments (**AWS, GCP**) to handle high-throughput customer, partner, and employee transactions.
* **Data Persistence Models:** Architect hybrid data persistence frameworks combining relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL platforms (MongoDB, DynamoDB), and high-precision vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector).
* **Ingestion Pipelines:** Design data ingestion, chunking, and embedding workflows to transform unstructured organizational knowledge into high-precision search platforms.

### **4. Technical Leadership, Execution & Stakeholder Management**

* **Engineering Standards & Roadmaps:** Set technical roadmaps, architectural standards, API contracts, and design patterns across global engineering squads.
* **Cross-Functional Strategy:** Partner closely with Product Management, Partner Solutions, Public Sector, and Technology Transformation teams to translate complex customer RFPs, migrations, and product goals into engineering blueprints.
* **Delivery & Global Team Management:** Direct software execution across hybrid onshore, offshore, and vendor IT teams using Agile and DevOps methodologies to maximize engineering velocity and throughput.
* **Validation & Iterative Review:** Lead technical reviews and demos with stakeholders to validate feature alignment against policy and operational constraints, rapidly integrating user feedback into system specs.
* Leading the technology charter for the development, engineering and solutioning using the latest technology stack infusing AI into the product development
* Innovating

  + Championing the adoption of Generative AI technologies across the organization.
  + Identifing emerging trends and opportunities in AI and propose innovative solutions.
  + Conducting workshops and training sessions to educate team members on Generative AI technologies and best practices
* Performance Monitoring and Improvement:

  + Establishing metrics to evaluate the performance and effectiveness of AI solutions.
  + Continuously assessing and optimize AI models and algorithms for better accuracy and efficiency.
  + Ensuring that AI implementations adhere to ethical standards and regulatory requirements.
  + Advocating for responsible AI practices within the organization.
  + Developing highly-available applications and service stacks in production environments.
  + Providing architectural oversight for systems and services
  + Promoting, implementing, and educating about Agile software development
  + Staying updated with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to drive continuous improvement
  + Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of development efforts with business objectives
  + Bringing in new ideas towards unlocking the unarticulated needs of our customers in the Digital channels infusing AI
  + Delivering on the AGILE KPI’s and driving incremental improvements on Quality, Supply Demand Capacity, on time completion of milestones and positive business outcomes

**What we’re looking for...**

You have the ability to define a vision and your ambitious attitude drives you to generate highly innovative ideas and take calculated risks. You develop positive relationships and innovative solutions, which makes you a productive collaborator. Customers appreciate that you take personal responsibility for their satisfaction, and team members know they can count on your commitment.

**You’ll need to have:**

* Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
* Six or more years of relevant work experience.
* Proven experience as an AI architect or similar role, with a focus on Generative AI
* Technical Skills
* Proficiency in programming languages (Python, Java, etc.).
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and AI services.
* Software development experience in a diverse set of areas including scalable web applications
* Experience in Java/J2EE application development including experience leading a technical team in such web technologies.
* Experience in a DevOps software development environment.
* Experience migrating web applications to Cloud (AWS, Oracle Cloud or Cloud Foundry etc.)
* Knowledge and experience of Docker/Container technologies
* Exceptional communication and collaboration skills.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.
* Ability to lead and inspire teams in a fast-paced environment.

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* A degree in computer science or computer engineering.
* Evaluate and choose appropriate technologies, design patterns, and algorithms for the development of robust and scalable software solutions
* Innovation mindset
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills ability to assimilate data from varied sources, apply deductive reasoning and scientific method, make inferences, draw testable conclusions, and resolve problems.

40

* Lead administrator enablement programs and CoE development initiatives.
* Conduct architecture reviews and governance forums.
* Establish operational documentation standards and knowledge repositories.
* Coordinate with Atlassian Support and external vendors for complex issues.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of overall IT experience.
* 5+ years administering Jira Align in enterprise environments.
* Deep expertise in:
  + Jira Align configuration and administration
  + Enterprise Agile planning frameworks
  + Jira administration
  + Jira-Jira Align connectors
  + Portfolio and Program management structures
* Strong expertise in Enterprise Insights architecture and SQL-based reporting.
* Extensive experience with Power BI and executive reporting solutions.
* Advanced experience with Microsoft Power Automate and enterprise workflow automation.
* Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, authentication, and security models.
* Experience leading governance initiatives, CoEs, and platform transformation programs.
* Excellent stakeholder management and consulting skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Atlassian Certified Jira Align Administrator.
* Atlassian Certified Jira Administrator.
* Microsoft Power Platform certifications.
* Microsoft Power BI certifications.
* Experience in regulated enterprise environments.
* Experience leading large-scale Jira Align implementations and migrations.

**Position Summary:**

  

The Officer, Enterprise Integration Specialist will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining integrations across cybersecurity, engineering, operations, identity, and data platforms. The role will enable the onboarding of new data sources, automate workflow orchestration, and establish seamless connectivity between enterprise systems to improve operational efficiency, risk visibility, and remediation effectiveness.

This position will serve as a key technical partner across Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Application Development, Risk, and Enterprise Architecture teams to ensure data flows, system integrations, and business processes are scalable, reliable, and well-governed.

  
  
  

### **Key Responsibilities:**

  
  

***Integration & Data Onboarding-***

  

* Design and implement integrations to onboard new enterprise data sources, including vulnerability scanners, asset inventories, cloud security platforms, and operational tooling.
* Develop API-based, event-driven, and batch integrations to aggregate and normalize data from disparate systems.
* Define and maintain integration standards, schemas, and data mapping frameworks.
  

  

***Workflow Automation & Orchestration-***

  

* Automate end-to-end workflows across security, engineering, operations, and governance processes.
* Enable automated ticket creation, assignment, escalation, remediation tracking, and reporting.
* Design workflow integrations that improve traceability and reduce manual effort across teams.
* Enterprise Platform Integration

* Jira

* ServiceNow
* IAM
* GCS Data Lakehouse and enterprise data platforms
* Vulnerability management and security scanning solutions
* CI/CD and DevSecOps toolchains
* Asset management and CMDB platforms
  

  

**Data Engineering & Analytics-**

* Create integration patterns that support enterprise reporting, analytics, dashboards, and operational metrics.
* Ensure data quality, lineage, governance, and auditability across integrated systems.
  

  

**Stakeholder Collaboration-**

* Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, and Engineering Leads to develop integration roadmaps and delivery plans.
* Support onboarding of new platforms, capabilities, and enterprise services.
  

  

**Security & Compliance-**

  

* Ensure integrations comply with enterprise security, privacy, and data governance standards.

* Support audit, regulatory, and risk-management initiatives as required.

* Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as Jira, GitHub, ServiceNow, and identity management systems.

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.

* Experience integrating cybersecurity, vulnerability management, and risk-management platforms.
* Familiarity with SailPoint, cloud platforms, and enterprise data lake architectures.
* Knowledge of event-driven architectures, microservices, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience in Financial Services or other highly regulated industries.

* Improved visibility, traceability, and reporting across workflows.

title: Principal Data Architect - Multi-Cloud (GCP & Azure)
description:
We are seeking a Principal Data Architect to define and drive enterprise data architecture, modernization, and governance strategies across complex multi-cloud (Google Cloud Platform and Microsoft Azure) and hybrid environments. This role will design scalable, secure, and high-performing data platforms while partnering with business and engineering leaders to translate strategic objectives into impactful data solutions.

A key focus of this role will be spearheading scalable, agent-driven data migration pipelines to transition legacy on-premises data assets to the cloud, setting the technical direction for engineering teams, and actively managing the customer's technical backlog and delivery roadmap.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Multi-Cloud Lakehouse Architecture: Lead the end-to-end architecture, design, and implementation of scalable Data Lakehouse solutions across Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, GCS, BigLake, Dataplex) and Microsoft Azure (Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, ADLS Gen2, Azure Databricks).
* On-Prem to Cloud Migration & Agentic Pipelines: Architect and deploy automated, scalable, agent-driven data pipelines (leveraging GenAI agents and metadata-driven frameworks) to orchestrate, validate, and accelerate complex migrations from on-premises legacy warehouses/databases (Oracle, Teradata, SQL Server) to GCP and Azure.
* Client Engagement & Advisory: Collaborate directly with customers to understand business goals, data challenges, and technical requirements; translate them into robust architectural blueprints, technical roadmaps, and actionable delivery plans.
* Customer Technical Backlog Management: Own and actively manage the customer technical backlog—translating business epics into technical user stories, prioritizing technical debt, defining sprint milestones, and aligning backlog items with business ROI.
* Modern Ingestion & Streaming: Design and implement data pipelines supporting both real-time and batch ingestion using modern orchestration (Cloud Composer, Azure Data Factory, Airflow) and streaming/messaging frameworks (Kafka, GCP Pub/Sub, Azure Event Hubs).
* Governance & Lineage: Establish and enforce best practices for unified data cataloging, metadata management, automated lineage, and data quality across multi-cloud and on-prem systems using Dataplex, Microsoft Purview, or open-source governance tools.
* Security & Compliance: Define and implement robust data security, identity management (IAM / Azure Entra ID), encryption, row/column-level access control, and regulatory compliance standards across clouds.
* Team Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Steer the overarching technical direction of engineering teams; establish architectural standards, mentor senior and mid-level engineers, conduct architecture review, and ensure engineering excellence.
* Hands-on Delivery & Prototyping: Balance strategic architecture discussions with hands-on solutioning, architectural spikes, Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), and performance tuning of complex multi-cloud distributed workloads.
* Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with enterprise architects, delivery leads, DevOps engineers, and customer stakeholders to drive solution adoption, operational scalability, and long-term platform maintainability

### **Technical Experience & Tooling**

Candidates should demonstrate hands-on architecture and design experience across the following domains:

* Cloud Platforms: Deep expertise in both Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Microsoft Azure enterprise data ecosystems.
* Processing Engines: Apache Spark, PySpark, Databricks, Azure Synapse / Fabric Spark, GCP Dataproc.
* Modern Migration & AI Automation: Building automated, agentic, or metadata-driven data migration pipelines, automated schema conversion, and data validation agents for on-prem to cloud lift-and-shift/re-platforming.
* Messaging & Streaming: Apache Kafka, GCP Pub/Sub, Azure Event Hubs.
* Orchestration: Apache Airflow, Google Cloud Composer, Azure Data Factory (ADF).
* Analytical Storage & Warehouses: GCP BigQuery, Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, Delta Lake/Parquet.
* NoSQL / Cache Storage: MongoDB, Redis, Bigtable, Azure Cosmos DB.
* Containerization & Deployment: Kubernetes (GKE and AKS), Cloud Run, Azure Container Apps.
* API Frameworks: Python (FastAPI, Flask) for data service endpoints.
* Databases & Querying: Advanced SQL validation and extraction from legacy/RDBMS systems (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL).
* CI/CD & Version Control: Git, GitHub, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

### **Required Qualifications & Skills**

* 15+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, and Enterprise Data Platform architecture.
* 5+ years architecting, migrating, and deploying production data platforms across GCP and/or Azure, with proven multi-cloud integration patterns.
* Demonstrated track record leading on-premises/cloud to cloud modernization/migration initiatives, including data ingestion, transformation, automated data reconciliation, and cutover strategies.
* Experience designing or integrating autonomous, agent-driven, or LLM-augmented data workflows (e.g., automated schema mapping, code conversion, data quality validation agents).
* Proven hands-on experience designing and deploying Lakehouse platforms incorporating Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and Data Mesh / Data Product principles.
* Deep knowledge of multi-cloud data governance, access management, and cataloging (Dataplex, Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog).
* Strong leadership capability in technical backlog management, agile scoping, sprint planning, and setting technical strategy for distributed teams.
* Exceptional stakeholder communication skills: capability to articulate architectural trade-offs to C-level executives as smoothly as reviewing code with engineers.

### **Preferred Qualifications (Optional / Good to Have)**

* Multi-cloud certifications: *Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer / Cloud Architect* and/or *Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate / Azure Solutions Architect Expert*.
* Hands-on knowledge of Snowflake and Databricks
* Familiarity with AWS data services (Amazon S3, Redshift, Glue, EMR).
* Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or agentic framework integrations in data operations.

### **Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

description:

* Design, develop, integrate, deliver, and continuously enhance highly scalable distributed software solutions.
* Collaborate with software engineers, architects, product managers, and partner teams across the Agile software development lifecycle.

* Refine and groom features and user stories, providing accurate effort estimates and implementation plans.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and potential challenges, and communicate them proactively to stakeholders.

* Drive the resolution of technical debt, security vulnerabilities, and outdated third-party components.
* Maintain product scalability, reliability, security, and performance standards.
* Mentor and coach engineers on software design, architecture, and development best practices.
* Guide teams in building highly available, secure, and distributed software systems.
* Contribute to the ongoing innovation, evolution, and success of software products and solutions.
Foster effective communication, collaboration, and knowledge sharing across cross-functional teams.
