Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

**Required Skills and Experience**

  

• Lead functional workshops for Invoice-to-Cash (ITC) processes across Order Management (OM), Accounts Receivable (AR), Advanced Pricing, Credit Management, Revenue Management, and Collections in Oracle Fusion Financials & SCM Cloud.

• 10–15+ years of ERP experience with 7+ years in Oracle Fusion Financials Cloud, focused on Invoice-to-Cash (AR, OM, Pricing, RMCS).

• Analyze current-state receivables and billing processes and design future-state ITC flows aligned with Oracle Fusion Cloud best practices.

• Configure Oracle Fusion modules including Accounts Receivable (AR), OM, Advanced Pricing, Credit Management, Auto Invoice, Revenue Accounting (RMCS), and related setups.

• Develop and maintain Business Process Design (BPD) documents,

Configuration Workbooks, Functional Design Specifications (FDS), and end-to-end ITC process documentation.

• Configure and support customer master data, transaction types, invoicing rules, accounting rules, receipt methods, lockboxes, tax integration, and revenue recognition.

• Validate ITC integration touchpoints with Order-to-Cash (OTC),

Record-to-Report (R2R), Procure-to-Pay (PTP), SCM, Tax, and EPM modules.

• Collaborate with integration teams to define and test interfaces for orders, invoices, receipts, credit memos, revenue data, and customer balances using OIC, FBDI, REST/SOAP APIs.

• Support Auto Invoice, receipt processing, bank lockbox, customer payments, adjustments, write-offs, disputes, and collections workflows.

• Ensure accurate Subledger Accounting (SLA) for Accounts Receivable,

including revenue, tax, freight, and adjustments posting to GL.

• Support ITC-related data migration including customer conversion, open AR balances, invoices, receipts, and historical revenue data.

• Create and execute test scenarios for SIT, UAT, regression testing, and

end-to-end Order-to-Cash cycles.

• Validate ITC accounting accuracy across AR subledger, SLA rules, RMCS postings, and GL reconciliation. Oracle Invoice-to-Cash (ITC) Functional Consultant.

• Provide functional support during cutover, go-live, deployments, and hyper care activities.

• Collaborate with reporting teams to validate OTBI, BI Publisher, AR Aging, Revenue reports, and customer statements.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

  

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Engineering, or related discipline.

• Strong understanding of Order-to-Cash and Invoice-to-Cash processes,

revenue recognition, customer billing, credit management, and collections.

• Hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Accounts Receivable, Auto Invoice, receipt processing, lockbox, and SLA configuration.

• Experience with Revenue Management (RMCS) and compliance with ASC 606/ IFRS 15.

• Familiarity with upstream integrations from SCM / OM and downstream financial reporting requirements.

• Experience working with integrations using OIC, FBDI, REST/SOAP APIs, and ITC reporting tools (OTBI, BI Publisher).

• Hands-on experience with data migration for customers, AR balances, invoices and receipts.

• Experience supporting multi-currency, multi-ledger, and multi-region

environments.

• Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Prior experience supporting multi-region Oracle Cloud implementations (NA,EMEA, APAC).

• Experience managing quarterly Oracle Cloud updates and assessing impact on ITC processes.

• Preferred Certifications: Oracle Cloud Financials Certification (AR / OM /RMCS).

  
  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

description:

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

The Data Platform & Services organization delivers enterprise data, analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), and cloud capabilities that enable scalable, secure, and trusted data solutions across the business. The team is responsible for modernizing data platforms, advancing cloud adoption, and establishing foundational data services that support operational excellence, analytics, and digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
As the Senior IT Supervisor, Data Engineering, you will drive the implementation of foundational data capabilities that support a variety of business functions. You will cultivate strategic partnerships with stakeholders to successfully implement cloud-based technologies that acquire, process, and store data across multiple latency requirements, enabling Data as a Service (DaaS) and Analytics as a Service (AaaS). You will lead delivery execution and engineering teams focused on data modernization, cloud platforms, AI-enabled solutions, and enterprise data services while advancing engineering excellence, operational reliability, and business value through scalable data solutions.  
  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of Data, AI, and Cloud initiatives, including platform modernization, migration, integration, and analytics solutions.
* Establish engineering standards, quality controls, testing practices, and release readiness processes to ensure first-time quality delivery.
* Manage delivery plans, dependencies, risks, issues, resource allocation, and governance activities in partnership with program and project stakeholders.
* Coach, mentor, and develop data, cloud, and AI engineering teams through performance feedback, technical guidance, and career development planning.
* Implement and scale Agile practices including Scrum and Kanban, driving sprint execution, backlog management, capacity planning, and delivery forecasting.
* Partner with business stakeholders, Product Owners, Architects, and Security teams to align technology solutions with business priorities and enterprise standards.
* Provide technical leadership for data platforms, cloud technologies, AI solutions, data pipelines, integration frameworks, and operational excellence initiatives.
Drive platform reliability, cost optimization, continuous improvement, incident resolution, and operational performance across enterprise data and cloud environments.  

  

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* 10+ years of IT experience with a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, MCA, MSc or MBA.
* Experience leading technical teams, coaching engineers, managing performance, and improving delivery effectiveness.
* Experience with Databricks and Snowflake platforms, including data engineering, integration, data processing, and platform modernization initiatives.
* Experience managing enterprise technology programs, including scope, schedule, risk, dependency, governance, and resource management.
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies, cloud platforms, CI/CD practices, data architecture, and operational support processes.
* Experience delivering global enterprise-scale Data, AI, and Cloud programs across multiple business functions and technology platforms.
Knowledge of data governance, responsible AI, privacy, security, and compliance requirements within regulated industries.  

  

Nice to have:

* Previous Medtronic experience.
* Experience with Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Large Language Model (LLM) solutions.
* Experience with DataOps, MLOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), workflow orchestration, observability, and automated deployment practices.
Experience driving cloud financial management, platform consumption optimization, and FinOps initiatives.

title: OMEGAMON Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

As an OMEGAMON Specialist at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.
  
  
There’s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Implement and maintain OMEGAMON monitoring infrastructure.
* Monitor health of z/OS, CICS, DB2, IMS, MQ, and storage subsystems.
* Develop automated alerting and event correlation.
* Create dashboards and operational reporting.
* Support proactive detection of performance degradation.
Integrate monitoring data with AIOps and Bridge analytics initiatives.  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

### **Required Technical Skills**

  

* 5+ years of experience in OMEGAMON Suite Administration and Mainframe Monitoring.
* Strong experience with IBM OMEGAMON Suite and Tivoli Monitoring.
* Knowledge of Enterprise Monitoring Architecture and monitoring best practices.
* Expertise in RMF and SMF analysis for performance monitoring and capacity planning.
* Experience in performance baseline development and trend analysis.
* Strong understanding of event correlation and threshold management.
* Expertise in root cause analysis and systems diagnostics.
* Knowledge of automation concepts and AIOps integration.
* Experience with Microsoft Windows Server 2016/2019 implementation, administration, and management.
* Hands-on experience with VMware ESXi and virtualization technologies.
* Experience managing public and private cloud environments, including migration from on-premises infrastructure to cloud solutions.
* Familiarity with vulnerability management, security compliance, and infrastructure hardening.
* Experience with Microsoft Active Directory and Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS).
* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation technologies.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.  

  

### **Preferred Skills**

  

* IBM OMEGAMON or IBM Z Monitoring certifications.
* Experience with IBM Z Monitoring Suite, IBM Tivoli Monitoring (ITM), and IBM NetView.
* Knowledge of IBM Z AIOps, Watson AIOps, or similar AIOps platforms.
* Experience integrating monitoring data with Splunk, Elastic, Grafana, or other enterprise analytics tools.
* Familiarity with System Automation for z/OS (SA z/OS) and automation frameworks.
* Knowledge of z/OSMF, Parallel Sysplex, and IBM Z infrastructure.
* Experience with REXX, JCL, and automation scripting.
* Understanding of CICS, Db2, IMS, MQ, and enterprise storage performance monitoring.
* Experience with ITIL Incident, Problem, and Event Management processes.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Experience supporting 24x7 mission-critical enterprise production environments.
* Ability to mentor team members and contribute to monitoring strategy and continuous service improvement initiatives.
Experience with cloud automation, IaC frameworks, and enterprise monitoring modernization initiatives.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Director, AI and Data Platform Delivery
description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**Role Overview**

The Senior Director of AI and Data Platform Delivery is a senior leadership role accountable for **end‑to‑end execution of Teradata’s foundational AI and data platform offerings**, which underpin the company’s hybrid, multi‑cloud, and on‑premises solutions. This role is critical to ensuring that Teradata’s **platform continues to scale, modernize, and reliably support customer workloads**, while enabling company growth through platform differentiation, adoption, and expansion.

This leader owns the **execution strategy, operating model, and talent development** for a combined organization of **Technical Program Managers (TPMs)** and **Global Program Managers (GPMs)**. Together, these teams drive coordinated execution across the end-to-end **New Product Introduction (NPI) process**, ensuring that new platform elements are fully productized, operationally ready, and commercially viable.

Success in this role is measured by **platform delivery predictability, quality, scalability, and business impact**, rather than ownership of individual programs.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Platform Execution & Growth Enablement**

* Own execution outcomes for significant areas of Teradata’s **core data platform and AI roadmap**, including platform modernization, scalability enhancements, cloud parity, and operational hardening.
* Be accountable for execution work that **enables Teradata’s growth and retention targets**, including platform readiness for new use cases, expansions, and customer adoption.
* Translate product and platform strategy into **integrated execution plans** that balance stability, innovation, customer commitments, and long‑term technical health.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Commercial leadership to align platform execution with **market needs, competitive positioning, and revenue objectives**.
* Provide execution transparency and decision support to senior leadership for **tradeoffs impacting delivery, quality, and customer trust**.

**End‑to‑End New Product Introduction (NPI) Leadership**

* Lead the global NPI execution model for core and AI platform capabilities from concept through general availability and sustained customer adoption.
* Ensure cross‑functional coordination across:
* + Definition, development, and testing
  + Product setup, configuration, and entitlement
  + Legal, compliance, and contractual readiness
  + Pricing, packaging, and lifecycle management
  + Go‑to‑market readiness (Sales, Marketing, Solution Architects)
  + Cloud Operations, infrastructure, and SRE readiness
  + Customer support, field enablement, and documentation
* Establish scalable, repeatable NPI mechanisms that support **frequent platform releases and long‑lived customer environments**.

**Technical & Platform Leadership**

* Provide technical and execution leadership across **large‑scale, distributed, data‑intensive platforms**, spanning cloud, hybrid, and on‑prem deployments.
* Guide teams through complex platform delivery challenges involving **performance, reliability, scalability, security, upgrade paths, and operational continuity**.
* Ensure cross‑team technical and operational risks are proactively identified, clearly owned, and mitigated.
* Partner with senior engineering and architecture leaders to ensure execution plans align with **long‑term platform sustainability and customer trust**.
* Co-own with engineering **platform economics and cost‑to‑serve** by influencing execution tradeoffs that impact margin, scaling limits, and long‑term pricing power.
* Co-own with engineering and product the **platform lifecycle governance and technical debt liquidation** at the portfolio level.

**People & Organizational Leadership**

* Build, lead, and scale a high‑impact organization of **Technical Program Managers and Global Program Managers**.
* Clearly define and reinforce roles and interfaces between TPMs (engineering‑centric delivery) and GPMs (cross‑functional, post‑code, market and operational readiness).
* Own hiring, performance management, development, and succession planning for the platform execution organization.
* Develop senior TPM and GPM leaders capable of operating effectively at **enterprise scale and high ambiguity**.
* Establish clear leveling, expectations, and promotion readiness standards for both TPM and GPM career paths.

**Influence, Communication & Executive Partnership**

* Act as a **trusted execution advisor** to senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Cloud Operations, Sales Engineering, Legal, and Customer organizations.
* Communicate platform execution health, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs clearly at the **VP and executive level**.
* Drive alignment across a highly matrixed organization supporting long‑lived, mission‑critical customer environments.
* Provide executive clarity during high‑impact incidents, major releases, or customer‑sensitive platform transitions.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering leadership, product operations, or related technical roles.
* 5+ years of experience leading senior technical and program management professionals.
* Proven success delivering **large‑scale, enterprise data platform initiatives**.
* Strong understanding of **distributed systems, database platforms, cloud infrastructure, and hybrid architectures**.
* Demonstrated ability to drive execution that supports **business growth, customer retention, and platform adoption**.
* Exceptional executive‑level communication and influence skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering or operating **enterprise data platforms** in cloud and hybrid environments.
* Background supporting **platform modernization, cloud transitions, or large customer migrations**.
* Experience building or scaling global NPI and release governance models.
* Familiarity with operational excellence, SRE practices, and enterprise reliability expectations.

**What Success Looks Like**

A successful Senior Director of AI and Data Platform Delivery:

* Enables Teradata to **deliver and evolve its core platform with predictability and confidence**.
* Holds the organization to **best-in-breed standards** across delivery quality, platform performance, and operational reliability — ensuring Teradata's core data platform earns a reputation for excellence.
* Scales execution capabilities to support platform growth, modernization, and increased customer demand.
* Ensures platform capabilities are fully **productized, operationally ready, and commercially viable**.
* Builds a strong TPM and GPM organization trusted across Product, Engineering, and GTM teams.
* Directly supports Teradata’s **growth and retention goals** by strengthening the foundation of its data platform.

title: Principal Applied Scientist
description:
**Overview**

**Overview**

Microsoft Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO+I) underpins Microsoft’s global cloud infrastructure, driving the innovation, planning, design, construction, and operation of one of the largest data center fleets in the world. We are seeking an exceptional **Principal Applied Scientist** to join the **Data Center Applied AI** team. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in advancing and integrating **cutting‑edge, multimodal agentic AI systems** into core tools and operational workflows that power Microsoft’s data centers. Your work will drive operational efficiency at scale and help advance Microsoft’s mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more through intelligent, multimodal AI agents.

As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will **bridge state‑of‑the‑art AI research with production‑grade engineering**, delivering agent architectures that are **reliable, secure, scalable, observable, and measurable**. You will collaborate closely with Business and Engineering to build and deploy agentic capabilities across workflow automation, information retrieval, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), tool and function calling, long‑horizon task execution, and multi‑agent orchestration.

This role blends deep AI and applied science expertise with strong engineering judgment, operational rigor, and a bias for action. Success requires end‑to‑end ownership, a growth mindset, and strong customer empathy. Join us to shape the future of agentic AI for data center operations at global scale.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We work with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize shared goals—guided by our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to foster an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 **Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities:**

* **Advance Applied AI Research to Improve Quality and Reliability**
  + Apply deep expertise in **Generative AI, deep learning, NLP, and multimodal models** to translate cutting-edge research into **high-impact, production-ready AI solutions**.
  + Design and execute experiments that measurably improve **agent planning, memory, grounding, reasoning, and long‑horizon task completion**.
  + Perform **lightweight fine‑tuning** (e.g., LoRA and related techniques) on multimodal and large multimodal language models—to improve entity recognition, reasoning accuracy, and response quality.
  + Implement state‑of‑the‑art approaches using **foundation models, advanced prompt engineering, RAG, knowledge graphs, and multi‑agent architectures**, complemented by classical ML techniques where appropriate.
* **Build and Ship Scalable Agentic AI Systems**
  + Architect and implement **end‑to‑end agent workflows** that decompose user intent into executable plans, intelligently select and invoke tools, and recover gracefully from errors and edge cases.
  + Rapidly prototype solutions and partner with engineering teams to drive **production deployment**, including debugging live systems and building **AIOps workflows**.
  + Use data and telemetry to identify AI quality gaps, generate insights, and deliver **proofs of concept** that apply research innovations to real‑world operational challenges.
  + Design robust **multi‑step reasoning and tool‑use strategies**, including function calling, code execution, APIs, and secure connectors, with strong safety and reliability guardrails.
  + Drive production excellence across **latency, reliability, cost efficiency, observability, monitoring, and safe fallback behaviors**.
* **Own Evaluation, Metrics, and Iteration Loops**
  + Define task‑level evaluation metrics for agentic behavior, including **success rate, tool‑call accuracy, step efficiency, hallucination rate, safety violations, time‑to‑completion, and user satisfaction**.
  + Build and maintain **offline and online evaluation pipelines**, including:
    - Golden datasets, scenario simulators, and regression test suites
    - Human‑in‑the‑loop evaluation frameworks and rubric design
    - A/B experimentation and telemetry‑driven iteration loops
* **Collaborate Across Disciplines and Lead Technical Execution**
  + Partner with business and engineering stakeholders to translate requirements into **clear technical specifications, research plans, and delivery milestones**.
  + Lead design reviews and influence engineering decisions across **agent frameworks, model integration, and system architecture**.
  + Mentor and support other applied scientists and engineers, raising the bar for **applied AI execution and production quality**

  
**Qualifications**

* **Required Qualifications**
* **PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, NLP**, or related field, OR 10 years of experience in delivering production grade AI systems.
* **10+ years** of hands‑on experience applying NLP, and/or LLMs to **real‑world production problems**.
* Strong foundation in **Large Language Models (LLMs)**, Generative AI, deep learning, and modern NLP.
* Proven experience building **production‑grade LLM systems**, including prompt engineering, RAG, and multi‑step reasoning pipelines.
* Solid expertise in **chunking strategies and embedding selection**, including tradeoffs in retrieval quality, context size, and downstream task performance.
* Experience designing and operating **vector databases**, including indexing strategies, similarity metrics, and retrieval optimization.
* Experience supporting **production operations (AIOps/MLOps)**, including monitoring, logging, quality metrics, and debugging live systems.
* Proficiency in **Python** and experience with modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and model serving/inference.
* Strong applied experimentation skills: defining metrics, analyzing results, and iterating based on data.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

While not required, we also look for the following**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Cloud technology Stack
* Experience with **parameter‑efficient fine‑tuning** techniques (e.g., LoRA) for LLMs or multimodal models.
* Hands‑on experience building **agentic or tool‑augmented LLM systems**, including function calling, planners, and API/tool integration.
* Experience with **advanced RAG architectures**, such as hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, and citation strategies.
* Strong **AIOps depth**, including quality drift detection, alerting, rollback, and telemetry‑driven optimization.
* Experience optimizing systems for **latency, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency** at enterprise scale.
* Prior experience working on **mission‑critical or large‑scale enterprise AI systems**.
* Demonstrated mentorship or technical leadership within applied science or engineering teams.

**Background Check Requirements:**

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

title: Associate Engineering Director
description:

**A Day in the Life**

As an Associate Engineering Director at Medtronic, you will be a second-line leader accountable for a software organization spanning multiple teams and product areas. You will lead through both engineers and other managers, owning the health, capability, and delivery performance of your organization. Where an Engineering Manager drives a team, you will shape the technical and organizational strategy across teams, build the leadership bench beneath you, and serve as a primary partner to R&D, Quality, Regulatory, and Program Management leadership on multi-year roadmap.  

**A Day in the Life**

As an Associate Engineering Director at Medtronic, you will be a second-line leader accountable for a software organization spanning multiple teams and product areas. You will lead through both engineers and other managers, owning the health, capability, and delivery performance of your organization. Where an Engineering Manager drives a team, you will shape the technical and organizational strategy across teams, build the leadership bench beneath you, and serve as a primary partner to R&D, Quality, Regulatory, and Program Management leadership on multi-year roadmap.

  

**You Will:**

· Lead a multi-team software organization (typically 40+ engineers) designing and developing software applications for medical devices across web, mobile, desktop, and cloud.

· Manage, coach, and develop Engineering Managers and senior technical leads; build succession plans and a strong leadership pipeline within your organization.

· Own end-to-end delivery across your operating unit: capacity and resource planning, multi-project prioritization, dependency management, risk escalation, and executive-level reporting on commitments and metrics.

· Partner with the broader R&D organization (Quality, Systems, Regulatory, Clinical) and with global sites to align on design controls, V&V strategy, and submission readiness.

· Define and institutionalize sustainable product development processes; drive continuous improvement in engineering practices, quality, and cycle time across teams, not just within one team.

· Own hiring strategy, workforce planning, vendor/partner engagement, and budget inputs for your organization.

· Represent the software organization to OU and site leadership, and in design reviews, phase gates, and audits.

· Remove systemic barriers, resolve cross-team conflicts, and create the conditions for teams to deliver predictably.

· Champion a culture of engineering excellence, psychological safety, patient safety, and compliance.

  

Engineers create our market-leading portfolio of innovations. Combine the best of your experience with training and mentorship to move your career forward. If you want a challenging, energizing, rewarding career that changes lives, join us. Help us bring the next generation of life-changing medical technology to patients worldwide.

If you are a pioneer and would like to have a big impact into the new world of medical robotics – then come join our team!

  

**Must Have: Minimum Requirements**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum of 18+ years of applicable work experience in a SW product development & Global team environment.
* Minimum 8+ years of people-management experience, including 2+ years leading multiple teams simultaneously.
* Deep understanding of enterprise application full stack development (desktop, mobile, cloud) and V&V strategy, including automated verification.
* Experience in developing and maintaining a deep technical understanding of product lines and technologies.
* Experience in developing departmental budget and manages expenses in line with organizational objectives; approves departmental expenditures including capital and manpower expense.
* Excellent Technology management, project management skills; demonstrated success executing complex engineering projects with diverse technical teams.
* Proven ability to lead programs within a global matrix structure, including influencing peers and leaders without direct authority.
* Demonstrated ability to blend organizational leadership with credible technical depth — able to set strategy and to engage substantively in architecture and design decisions.
* Track record of developing engineers with measurable outcomes in retention, promotion, and capability growth.
* Excellent communication skills, including the ability to present status, risk, and strategy to senior leadership.

title: Principal ServiceNow Architect – ITSM & Enterprise Workflow
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Principal ServiceNow Architect to lead the architecture, solution design, technical governance, and implementation of scalable ServiceNow solutions. The individual will be responsible for translating business and IT requirements into secure, maintainable, and upgrade-friendly platform capabilities aligned with ITIL best practices and enterprise architecture standards.

The role requires a strong combination of ServiceNow platform expertise, hands-on technical proficiency, ITSM process knowledge, integration architecture, and stakeholder management. The candidate must be capable of independently handling complex technical challenges, evaluating existing implementations, identifying architectural gaps, and driving solutions from design through deployment and operational support.

The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, ITSM process owners, platform administrators, developers, integration teams, infrastructure teams, security teams, and delivery leadership.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise and Solution Architecture**

Define the ServiceNow platform architecture, technical standards, design principles, and implementation guidelines.

Translate business requirements and functional specifications into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions.

Lead architecture assessments, solution design reviews, technical feasibility assessments, and architectural decision-making.

Evaluate out-of-the-box capabilities against customization requirements and prioritize configuration over custom development wherever feasible.

Define reusable architectural patterns, application boundaries, data models, and integration approaches.

Maintain architecture documentation, solution design documents, technical specifications, and architecture decision records.

Assess existing implementations to identify technical debt, architectural inconsistencies, performance bottlenecks, and opportunities for simplification.

**2. ITSM and ITIL Process Architecture**

Design and govern ServiceNow ITSM capabilities, including Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Request Management, Knowledge Management, and Service Catalog.

Align platform workflows with ITIL 4 principles and enterprise service management policies.

Review and optimize incident categorization, impact, urgency, priority, assignment rules, escalation, and SLA management.

Define appropriate priority calculation and escalation models, ensuring that business impact and urgency drive consistent prioritization.

Establish standards for incident lifecycle management, major incident handling, problem investigation, change risk assessment, approvals, and service restoration.

Ensure that process implementations are consistent, measurable, auditable, and aligned with operational objectives.

Challenge unnecessary customizations or process variations that increase complexity without delivering measurable business value.

**3. Technical Architecture and Advanced Development**

Provide technical leadership for complex ServiceNow implementations, custom applications, workflows, and platform enhancements.

Demonstrate strong hands-on knowledge of JavaScript, GlideRecord, GlideAggregate, GlideSystem, GlideAjax, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and Flow Designer.

Design and troubleshoot advanced automation, event-driven processing, asynchronous operations, and complex workflow logic.

Define appropriate use of IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, scripting, scheduled jobs, events, and platform-native capabilities.

Review code for quality, security, scalability, performance, maintainability, and compliance with ServiceNow development standards.

Diagnose complex defects, production incidents, transaction failures, slow-running scripts, and unexpected platform behavior.

Establish development standards, code review practices, reusable components, and technical documentation.

**4. Integration and Data Architecture**

Design and govern integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems using REST APIs, SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and other supported integration mechanisms.

Define authentication, authorization, API security, error handling, retry mechanisms, monitoring, and integration resiliency.

Lead integration design across identity management, monitoring tools, ERP, CRM, HR, cloud platforms, and other enterprise applications.

Establish data ownership, data mapping, transformation, reconciliation, and validation standards.

Govern CMDB data integrations, identification and reconciliation rules, and data quality where applicable.

Troubleshoot integration failures, authentication issues, data inconsistencies, API errors, and performance constraints.

**5. Platform Governance, Security, and Performance**

Establish platform governance, development lifecycle standards, application access controls, and technical quality gates.

Ensure appropriate use of roles, ACLs, authentication, authorization, encryption, and sensitive-data controls.

Define instance strategy, application scope, update-set or application deployment practices, and environment promotion controls.

Establish release, upgrade, regression-testing, and rollback strategies in collaboration with platform operations.

Assess customization impact on upgrades and minimize upgrade conflicts.

Monitor platform health, transaction performance, script efficiency, integration reliability, and technical debt.

Ensure compliance with enterprise security policies, audit requirements, and applicable governance standards.

**6. CMDB, Service Mapping, and ITOM**

Define CMDB architecture, configuration item classes, relationships, ownership, and data quality controls.

Establish configuration management standards and alignment between business services, technical services, and supporting infrastructure.

Provide architectural guidance for Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and operational visibility where these capabilities are in scope.

Define integration patterns for infrastructure monitoring and service health data.

Ensure that CMDB and operational data support incident impact analysis, change risk assessment, and service availability objectives.

**7. ServiceNow Product and Platform Strategy**

Evaluate and recommend appropriate ServiceNow capabilities across ITSM, ITOM, IT Asset Management, Strategic Portfolio Management, HR Service Delivery, Customer Service Management, Security Operations, and Integrated Risk Management, according to business needs.

Assess product fit, licensing implications, implementation complexity, dependencies, and business value.

Identify opportunities to consolidate fragmented workflows and reduce overlapping tools or custom-built solutions.

Define platform evolution roadmaps, capability maturity improvements, and modernization priorities.

Stay current with relevant ServiceNow releases, platform capabilities, architecture guidance, and recommended practices.

**8. Delivery Leadership and Stakeholder Management**

Partner with business stakeholders, process owners, product managers, project managers, and delivery teams to establish solution scope and technical priorities.

Lead architecture workshops, technical design discussions, proof-of-concept exercises, and solution demonstrations.

Provide technical direction and mentoring to developers, administrators, technical leads, and implementation partners.

Review estimates, technical dependencies, delivery risks, and implementation plans.

Support testing strategy, defect triage, deployment readiness, go-live, and post-production stabilization.

Communicate architectural decisions, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

12–15+ years of overall IT experience, with substantial hands-on ServiceNow experience.

Typically 8+ years of ServiceNow implementation and development experience, including significant ownership of complex technical solutions.

Demonstrated experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade ServiceNow architectures.

Strong knowledge of ITSM processes and ITIL principles; ITIL 4 certification is preferred.

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification; relevant implementation and architect-level certifications are strongly preferred.

Strong JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting expertise, including complex debugging and code reviews.

Proven experience with REST/SOAP integrations, authentication, data transformation, and integration troubleshooting.

Experience with platform security, access controls, performance optimization, release management, and upgrades.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.

Ability to work independently, make architecture decisions, explain technical trade-offs, and take ownership of complex issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer certification.

Relevant ServiceNow CIS certifications, particularly ITSM and ITOM where applicable.

ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect or Certified Master Architect credentials, where held and relevant to the role.

Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks, service management governance, and technical debt reduction.

Experience leading multi-team implementations, platform modernization, and enterprise integration programs.

**Expected Outcomes**

A clearly defined, documented, and governed ServiceNow architecture.

Consistent implementation of ITSM processes aligned with business policies and ITIL principles.

Improved platform stability, integration reliability, maintainability, and upgrade readiness.

Reduced unnecessary customization, technical debt, recurring defects, and avoidable production incidents.

Stronger code quality, security controls, documentation, and deployment governance.

A prioritized platform improvement roadmap tied to measurable business and operational outcomes.

title: Data Center HR Partner, AWS Builder Experience Team, BeXT
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join Amazon's Builder Experience Team (BeXT) as a Data Center HR Partner and make every day better for the Builders who power AWS. This is a 100% on\-site role where you'll be embedded in the Data Centers you support, serving as the voice of Builders and the strategic HR partner to site leadership. You'll work across a cluster of Data Centers, visiting sites daily to ensure every Builder feels valued, engaged, and supported.
  

  

What we are looking for:  

* Adaptability. Manage multiple scenarios utilizing HR expertise, consulting skills, and influence.
* High Judgement. Exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations. Serve as first point of escalation for Builder concerns.
* Strategic Thinking. Connect sentiment trends and HR data to bigger picture operational goals and translate them into clear recommendations that drive leadership action.
* Influencing. Influence multiple levels of the organization, from builders to senior site leaders, without direct authority.
* Coaching. Develop site leadership in the flow of work.

  

This is a 100% Onsite role and requires the ability to travel to assigned Data Center sites within an operational cluster (estimated 25% travel).  

* Data Center environments are 24/7 operational facilities; flexibility to support off\-shift populations and respond to time\-sensitive people matters is expected.
* This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports; leadership is demonstrated through influence, mentorship, and cross\-functional partnership.

  

Key job responsibilities  

Builder Advocacy: Build trust through consistent floor/onsite presence, site walks \& Gemba walks. Proactively monitor Builder sentiment trends using listening mechanisms. Support Builder queries with discretion and expertise. Foster and role model an environment of inclusion for all Builders, ensuring they feel fully engaged in their work and valued for who they are. Establish relationships with employee representative boards.  

  

Strategic Partnership: Partner with Data Center leaders at multiple levels to develop proactive strategies and goals focused on the Builder experience. Identify root causes using sentiment trends and HR data and provide site\-level recommendations to site leadership. Coordinate cluster\-wide communications in partnership with site leadership. Present at monthly All Manager and All Team Meetings.  

  

HR Expertise: Apply HR fundamentals to problem\-solve across talent management, performance management, compensation, and employee relations. Resolve complex cases independently, navigating Amazon Policies with high judgment. Conduct workplace investigations in collaboration with Builder Relations. Resolve systemic pay, internal transfer, and hiring defects in partnership with central teams. Build procedural policy/governance standards (e.g., SOPs).  

  

Leadership Development: Consult, coach, and develop site leadership through decision\-making with empathy and sound judgment. Identify development opportunities through data and anecdotal feedback from onsite floor walks and observation. Educate leaders on HR operating model standards. Support interviews for site manager and technical manager roles.  

  

Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work with partner teams such as HRBPs and Centers of Excellence (COEs) to innovate, implement, and deploy HR strategies across your cluster of Data Centers. Partner with New Hire Experience teams on orientation and onboarding. Manage through ambiguity in a fast\-paced, continuously innovating environment.  

  

A day in the life  

You'll conduct weekly Gemba walks, engaging directly with Builders to understand their experience. You'll leverage Builder sentiment data to advocate for their needs, partnering with site leaders to develop proactive strategies focused on engagement. You'll consult and coach leadership through talent management, performance management, compensation decisions, and employee relations issues—applying empathy and sound judgment. You'll collaborate with stakeholders to align on Builder engagement actions. You'll conduct workplace investigations, manage Builder concerns as the first point of escalation, and own site\-specific people projects that drive impact.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Human Resources Management, Labor Relations, Business/Management, Psychology, or a related field

* Experience supporting hourly/frontline populations of 100\+ employees in an operations or manufacturing environment
* Demonstrated experience in employee relations including conducting investigations and managing complex, high\-risk ER cases
* Working knowledge of local employment law

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in data center, critical infrastructure, construction, or technology operations environments
* Experience supporting a multi\-site or multi\-cluster scope across a geographic region

description:

### **What you’ll be doing...**


We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Lead SAM Flexera Expert to play a crucial "player\-coach" role within our Software Asset Management (SAM) function. You will architect the end\-to\-end publisher management strategy while actively working as a hands\-on implementor for our most complex, tier\-1 software publishers within the Flexera One platform. In this role, you will drive enterprise\-wide continuous cost optimization programs, manually design and configure complex licensing frameworks, serve as the lead technical defender during major vendor audits, and mentor a team of SAM professionals.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Defining the end\-to\-end lifecycle strategy for software publishers within Flexera, while rolling up your sleeves to directly execute the onboarding, configuration, and compliance monitoring for critical tier\-1 vendors.
* Acting as the primary authority and hands\-on implementor for translating highly complex EULAs, MSAs, and amendments into accurate license records and product use rights (PUR) within the platform.
* Directing and executing continuous cost optimization initiatives, actively diving into the data to identify strategic opportunities regarding shelfware, hybrid cloud licensing, and enterprise\-wide application rationalization.
* Leading the defense and data strategy during major software vendor audits, collaborating closely with IT Procurement, Legal, and Sourcing teams to mitigate financial risk.
* Executing advanced data normalization, beacon management, and hands\-on troubleshooting of the Flexera architecture to ensure optimal platform health.
* Overseeing the strategic roadmap and technically supporting the implementation of Flexera integrations with enterprise systems like ServiceNow CMDB, cloud portals (AWS/Azure/GCP), and discovery tools.
* Mentoring and guiding SAM analysts by leading by example, fostering a culture of continuous ITAM process improvement and technical excellence.
* Developing and presenting executive\-level reporting on software compliance risk, ELP status, and realized cost savings.
* Collaborating with Sourcing and Legal teams to maintain continuously updated compliance workpapers, defend against vendor audits, and proactively support contract renewals.

### **What we’re looking for...**


You are a strategic leader and hands\-on technical expert with an authoritative understanding of software asset management and complex publisher licensing frameworks. You possess excellent problem\-solving skills, a proven ability to execute complex platform configurations, and a passion for mentoring others. You thrive when balancing high\-stakes compliance strategy with the technical implementation required to realize multi\-million\-dollar cost\-saving opportunities.

### **You’ll need to have:**

* 9\+ years of experience in Software Asset Management (SAM) or IT Asset Management (ITAM), with at least 5\+ years of dedicated, hands\-on implementation and architecture experience in Flexera.
* Proven leadership experience blending end\-to\-end publisher lifecycle strategy with direct, hands\-on platform execution.
* Expert\-level understanding of software licensing frameworks for major vendors (e.g., Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, Adobe, SAP, Red Hat, VMware/Broadcom).
* Extensive technical experience managing ecosystem integrations and databases, including ServiceNow CMDB, SQL queries, REST APIs, and discovery agent operations.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex licensing data into actionable business strategies for leadership.

### **Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Flexera Certified Professional / Administrator (Flexera One / FNMS) and/or CSAM (Certified Software Asset Manager) or IAITAM certification.
* Scripting and automation skills (such as Python or PowerShell) to streamline API integrations and automate data management tasks.
* Understanding of how SAM intersects with Cybersecurity, specifically regarding the identification and management of End\-of\-Life (EOL) or End\-of\-Support (EOS) software to mitigate security risks.


If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

description:

SGS is the world’s leading Testing, Inspection and Certification company. We operate a network of over **2,500 laboratories and business facilities across 115 countries**, supported **by a team of over 100,000 dedicated professionals**. With **more than 145 years of service excellence**, we combine the precision and accuracy that define Swiss companies to help organizations achieve t**he highest standards of quality, compliance and sustainability.**


Our brand promise – **“when you need to be sure”** – underscores our commitment to **trust, integrity and reliability**, enabling businesses to **thrive with confidence**. We proudly deliver our **expert services** through the **SGS name** and a portfolio of **trusted specialized brands**, including **Applied Technical Services**, **Brightsight**, **Bluesign** and **Nutrasource**.

As an **EPM Solution Engineer**, you will act as a key technical expert for SGS's Hyperion, Essbase and related EPM applications, driving their development, stability and continuous improvement. You will ensure solutions follow industry best practices for coding, architecture, security and performance while applying your expertise across the software development lifecycle.


You will play an active role in development and enhancement initiatives, ensuring business requirements are understood, challenged where necessary, and translated into scalable, sustainable solutions. You will assess the impact of new requirements and provide technical guidance that balances business needs with long\-term system integrity and maintainability.


You will oversee the maintenance and support of EPM applications, including metadata management, calculation scripts, business rules, reports and dashboards. Working closely with business stakeholders, IT teams and service providers, you will manage requests, support incident resolution and contribute to strategic initiatives such as platform upgrades, ERP transformation projects and the evolution of Oracle EPM solutions.

* Oversee that the software development activity is carried out in accordance with SGS and market standards.

* Ensuring that development estimates made by partners are reasonable and acceptable.

* Manage and monitor issues closely and ensure their resolution according to applicable escalation procedures.
* Perform regular service quality checks on incident tickets and requests and prepare improvement plans.

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* **Minimum 5 years’ experience in Hyperion or related EPM products** on any of the following processes:
	+ Financial Planning and Budgeting.
	+ Enterprise Data Management \& **Essbase**.
	+ Financial Consolidation and Closing.
	+ EPM Technical Architecture.
* Strong hands\-on experience with EPM development, including business rules, calculation scripts, metadata management and reporting.
* Experience supporting, enhancing and maintaining enterprise EPM applications.
* **Oracle EPM Cloud experience** is highly desirable.
* Experience with EPM upgrades, migrations or transformation initiatives is desirable.
* Strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITIL) principles.
* Ability to assess the impact of business requirements and communicate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

**Required Skills**

* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to balance business requirements with long\-term system stability and architectural best practices.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to influence decisions and provide trusted technical guidance.
* Collaborative, adaptable and comfortable working across global teams and external partners.
* Proactive, flexible and able to thrive in a fast\-paced environment.
* Embraces change and continuous improvement.

  

**Additional Information** **Why SGS?**

* Join a globally recognized and stable company, a leader in the Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) industry.
* Enjoy a **flexible schedule and a hybrid work model.**
* Access continuous learning opportunities through SGS University and Campus.
* Collaborate in a multinational environment with colleagues from various continents.

**Apply Now**:  

At SGS, we are committed to fostering an open, friendly, and supportive culture that thrives on teamwork. We value diversity and provide endless opportunities to learn, grow your expertise, and fulfill your potential. Apply now to join our motivated and dynamic team!
